title: Personalreferent:in
description:
DateYork ist Teil der P&W Love Events GmbH und bringt seit 2011 Menschen im echten Leben zusammen. Wir veranstalten Speed Dating Events sowie unter unserer Marke You and Mee moderne Single Partys, Walks und besondere Eventformate in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.
 Was uns ausmacht: Wir sind ein wachsendes, modernes Eventunternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und immer neuen Projekten. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach Personalvorgänge ab – du sorgst mit dafür, dass in zahlreichen Städten besondere Events und echte Begegnungen entstehen.
 Aufgaben
 Bei uns verwaltest du nicht einfach Personal – du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Events stattfinden und die richtigen Menschen vor Ort sind.
 • Du findest und gewinnst neue Moderator:innen, Event-Guides und Veranstaltungspersonal für unsere Events in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.
 • Du führst Bewerbungsgespräche am Telefon, lernst unterschiedliche Menschen kennen und entwickelst schnell ein Gefühl dafür, wer wirklich zu uns passt.
 • Du übernimmst eigenständig die Personalplanung für unsere Events – von der ersten Anfrage bis zur finalen Besetzung.
 • Du bleibst dran: Du telefonierst, schreibst, fasst nach und sorgst dafür, dass offene Positionen nicht offen bleiben.
 • Wenn kurzfristig jemand absagt, wartest du nicht auf eine Lösung – du findest eine.
 • Du betreust unser bestehendes Eventpersonal, koordinierst Einsätze und stellst sicher, dass alle rechtzeitig alle wichtigen Informationen und Briefings erhalten.
 • Du baust unseren Personalpool kontinuierlich weiter aus, damit wir auch in neuen Städten schnell auf gute und zuverlässige Menschen zurückgreifen können.
 • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Personalbesetzung unserer größeren You and Mee Events – von unseren regelmäßigen Formaten bis zu Highlights wie Halloween und Silvester.
 Was uns dabei wichtig ist: Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig, bist schnell, verbindlich und möchtest am Ende deines Arbeitstages sehen…

title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.
 We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.
 The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.
 Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe .
 Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate !
 You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving.

title: Founding Senior Talent Partner
description:
About Odin
 Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.
 Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.
 We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.
 Why We're Hiring
 We're hiring across product, design, engineering, growth, legal and operations - and our US launch will add New York hiring on top of that. Hiring the right people is central to our success to not have someone focused on it entirely.
 You'll find exceptional people, but you won't just be the person holding everyone to a bar - you'll work with the founders and leadership team to shape what that bar actually looks like.
 This isn't a role where you speak to candidates and move them through a process. You'll understand the product, business and teams deeply enough to assess people properly, challenge hiring managers when needed, and hold the business to the same standard we expect from candidates.
 And because you'll often be the first person someone meets from Odin, you'll need to give exceptional people a reason to care about a company many of them haven't heard of yet.
 Employer brand is a core part of the role, not something you get to once hiring goes quiet. You'll help build the content, events and community engine that puts Odi…

title: Broker Development Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK
 Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.
 We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.
 We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!
 THE ROLE
 Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.
 WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:
 Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives.
